notes.17v.15: secura is feminine: the speaker of the Latin verse is a woman. zanuel, paruc, domello, astac, efranis, protanis and lezradis are kept as words of power; zanuel may be the 'sign' itself.

nodes.text: I, by the sign of the cross, not by shield
verse with it, the one that stands
